# Depvora

> CLI tool that scans Node.js/npm project dependencies for CVE vulnerabilities (via OSV + NVD), license conflicts, unused packages, and outdated versions, then can safely auto-fix them with automatic backup and rollback. Free and open source (MIT). Optional AI-powered recommendations via OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or a fully local/free Ollama model.

Depvora is a complement to `npm audit` and Dependabot for teams that also want license-conflict detection, unused-dependency detection, a historical health score with trend tracking, interactive dependency graphs, and safe automated fixes — in one CLI, with no GitHub integration required. Install with `npm install -g depvora`, then run `depvora analyze`. It does not replace `npm audit`/Dependabot; it covers what they don't.

## Install & usage

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AjayBThorat-20/depvora/main/README.md): install instructions, full command reference (`analyze`, `fix`, `cve`, `graph`, `snapshot`, `compare`, `history`, `timeline`, `backup`, `ai`, `llm`, `config`, `clean`), comparison vs. npm audit/Dependabot, CVE detection internals, AI provider setup, CI/CD integration, troubleshooting, and FAQ.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/depvora): install command, current version, download stats.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/AjayBThorat-20/depvora): source code, issue tracker.
